firstImportHint: Applied once. Later sync is two-way.
intro: Separate from sign-in. Only events are synced, and secrets stay on the server.
awaitingHint: Allow calendar access on the Google consent screen, then return here. If you canceled, connect again.
connectedHint: Pick a calendar and first-import direction. Later sync is two-way.
reauthHint: Google permission expired. Please connect again.
requestFailed: Could not complete the Google Calendar request.
envMissing: Google Calendar secrets are missing from the Edge Function.
fnMissing: The google-calendar Edge Function is not deployed.
fixEnv: Add GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID and CLIENT_SECRET on the server, then open this page again.
fixFn: Deploy the google-calendar and google-calendar-oauth functions to Supabase, then open this page again.
fixAuth: Sign in to Blanky, then return to this page.
fixDenied: Allow calendar access on the Google consent screen.
fixConnect: Use the connect button below to grant Google Calendar access.
fixCalendar: Pick a calendar from the connected account, then press Use this calendar.
fixHttp: Check the network, then try again.
fixInvalid: Refresh the page, then try again.
envView: Google Calendar can be connected once the server is available.
autoSyncHint: Opening this page refreshes a connection older than 5 minutes. Saving an event does not write to Google immediately.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Google Calendar? Events on Google are not deleted.
dropImported: Delete events imported into Blanky? Google events stay as they are.
